keyMoves.label: Greet and open politely
keyMoves.pattern: \b(good (morning|afternoon|evening)|welcome|thank you for (calling|holding|your time)|hello|hi|excuse me|my name is|this is)\b

keyMoves.label: Show empathy
keyMoves.pattern: \b(sorry|i understand|understand|frustrat\w*|don't worry|worr\w*|take your time|i can see|that must|apologi[sz]e|i know this|i'm glad|stressful|disappoint\w*)\b

keyMoves.label: Check or confirm details
keyMoves.pattern: \b(confirm|may i (have|see|ask|check)|could you (confirm|tell|give|spell|repeat)|is that (right|correct)|have i understood|just to (check|confirm)|let me (check|summarise|summarize|confirm)|so you|which|do you remember)\b

keyMoves.label: Explain clearly with times or numbers
Agree next steps and close
keyMoves.pattern: \b(reference|anything else|you're welcome|my pleasure|have a (good|nice|lovely|safe)|enjoy|next step|i'll (send|call|email|follow)|we'll (send|call)|please call)\b
